purpose: Teach: 操る/根元/下回る/追いかける/雇わ/不変/定住/外れる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラジコンを上手に操るのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is really good at operating that remote control car.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Speaking to her son with gentle pride in his father. Soft, conversational pace. A small smile in the voice — the kind of thing a parent says to draw a child's attention to someone he loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと木の根元に虫を見つけたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I found a bug under the tree roots!
lines.style: Bright, unrushed excitement. The words tumble out but with genuine wonder, not chaos. His voice carries the pride of discovery — he's sharing something he and Dad found together. Slightly breathless at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがテストの目標を下回ると残念だって
lines.en: Sho, it's too bad that Dad didn't quite meet his test score goal.
lines.style: Gentle, careful tone — she's translating something difficult into language a child can hold. Quiet beneath the surface. Not quite sad, but present with disappointment. Measured pace, like she's choosing each word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんを追いかけるの好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like running after Dad.
lines.style: Simple, earnest. No performance. The statement is complete in itself — small-voiced but certain. A slight pause before speaking, like he's thought about this. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい先生を雇われたって
lines.en: Sho, your dad hired a new teacher.
lines.style: Neutral information delivery, but with the slight weight of someone relaying news that matters. Even-paced. Watching how he receives it. A brief pause after 'teacher' — she's letting him sit with this for a moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんへの愛は不変だよ
lines.en: Mom, my love for Dad will always stay the same.
lines.style: Quiet, certain. Small voice, but the words carry weight — this is something he knows. Not precocious, not performed. The simplicity of a child stating something true. Gentle and still.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが田舎に定住されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa has settled down in the countryside.
lines.style: Conversational, low-pressure information-sharing. The tone of a parent passing along family news to her son. Slight pause between 'Grandpa' and 'has settled' — she's letting this land naturally. Warm but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ボタンが外れる前に直したいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to fix the button before it falls off.
lines.style: Practical concern mixed with earnest purpose. Direct and focused — he's thought about this. Not urgent, but important to him. Small voice, clear intention. Slight pause at 'button,' like he's picturing it.
